subject.title: fix: recover stuck Control UI chat runs

question: Should maintainers port this stale replacement branch to the current Control UI chat modules and require real behavior proof before merge?
rationale: The bug is still open and the watchdog direction is plausible, but the branch conflicts with the current UI architecture and lacks the required after-fix browser/gateway proof.

options.title: Port and prove the watchdog
options.body: Move the recovery into `ui/src/pages/chat/*`, refresh checks, and capture redacted proof that missed-terminal recovery reloads history and flushes the queued follow-up.

options.title: Override proof after manual review
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly waive the proof gate after reviewing the code and accepting the timer-driven session/message-delivery risk.

options.title: Pause or close this replacement
options.body: If the watchdog design is no longer worth porting, close or pause this PR and keep the canonical issue open for a different current-architecture fix.

recommendation.title: Port and prove the watchdog
recommendation.body: Move the recovery into `ui/src/pages/chat/*`, refresh checks, and capture redacted proof that missed-terminal recovery reloads history and flushes the queued follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: The current fix must be integrated into the split Control UI chat architecture, where recent chat split/session-control history points to this owner as the best routing candidate.
